title: A Beginner Class Looks Back: Our First Week
instructions: 这是为A1学习者设计的原创模拟听力与语法练习（非官方雅思测试）。先听/读对话，注意过去时 was/were、常用过去式、be going to 和 because 的用法。然后完成8道听力题和8道语法题。所有题目和选项均为英文，解释为中文。答案必须来自原文。
transcript:
Mia: Hi, Leo. How was your first English class?
Leo: It was good. But I was late. I was ten minutes late.
Mia: Oh no. Why were you late?
Leo: Because my bus was slow. The driver was very careful.
Mia: Were you nervous in class?
Leo: Yes, I was. But the teacher was kind. She said, "Don't worry."
Mia: What did you do in class?
Leo: We listened to a short story. Then we talked in pairs. I was tired after class.
Mia: Are you going to study tonight?
Leo: Yes, I am. I'm going to review new words because the test is on Friday.
Mia: Good plan. I'm going to help you. We were both late last week!
Leo: Thanks, Mia. You were a big help.

questions.explanation: Leo 说“I was ten minutes late.”，所以填 ten 或 10。
Leo 说“Because my bus was slow.”，所以选“Because his bus was slow.”。
Mia 问“Were you nervous in class?”，Leo 回答“Yes, I was.”，所以选“Yes, he was.”。

grammar.title: was / were 与 be going to 入门
grammar.explanation: 英语里说“过去是/在”用 was 或 were。I / he / she / it 用 was；you / we / they 用 were。否定：was not = wasn't，were not = weren't。问句把 was/were 放前面：Were you late? 说“打算做某事”用 be going to + 动词原形，be 随主语变：I am going to study. We are going to help. 原因用 because 连接。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about the past.
questions.explanation: 主语 I 在过去时用 was，所以第一项正确。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about the past.
questions.explanation: 主语 they 在过去时用 were，所以第二项正确。
questions.evidence: We were both late last week!

questions.prompt: Choose the correct question about the past.
questions.explanation: 主语 you 的过去时问句用 Were you...?，所以第二项正确。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct negative sentence about the past.
questions.explanation: 主语 she 的过去否定用 wasn't，所以第一项正确。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a plan.
options: I am going to study tonight.
I was going to study tonight.
answers: I am going to study tonight.
questions.explanation: 表示计划用 be going to + 动词原形，主语 I 用 am，所以第一项正确。
questions.evidence: I'm going to review new words because the test is on Friday.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a plan.
questions.explanation: 主语 we 用 are going to，所以第二项正确。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with because.
options: I was late because my bus was slow.
I was late because my bus is slow yesterday.
I was late because my bus were slow.
answers: I was late because my bus was slow.
questions.explanation: because 连接原因；my bus 是单数，过去用 was，所以第一项正确。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about the past.
questions.explanation: the teacher 是单数，过去用 was，所以第二项正确。
